title: Business Operations Program Analyst, NA
description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Business Operations Department

As a part of the Vantage Operations team, the Business Operations department is responsible for ensuring standards for operation performance, maintaining customer leases, producing monthly customer electivity bills, generating regular reports, and supporting Operational Effectiveness.  The Business Operations department also works closely with all Vantage departments to ensure customer success from the construction process through daily operations and delivery activities.

Position Overview

The Business Operations Program Analyst serves as a strategic partner to the Business Operations leadership team, responsible for evaluating operational performance across multiple functions, identifying emerging trends, risks, and opportunities, and providing actionable recommendations to support business decisions.

This role works across a diverse portfolio of operational programs and business functions, using existing data, reporting, and operational information to assess organizational performance, identify areas requiring leadership attention, and support continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate is naturally curious, highly analytical, and able to connect information across teams to develop meaningful insights that drive better business outcomes.

This role will be based in: Denver, CO or Ashburn, VA and is in alignment with our flexible work policy. (3 days on site required, 2 days flexible).

Essential Job Functions

Business Performance Analysis

- Analyze operational performance across multiple Business Operations programs and functions.

- Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance gaps impacting business objectives.

- Interpret data from operational systems, reports, audits, reviews, and stakeholder feedback to develop meaningful business insights.

- Evaluate organizational performance and provide recommendations to improve effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability.

- Prepare executive summaries, business reviews, and leadership briefings.

Strategic Decision Support

- Provide data-driven recommendations to support operational and strategic decision-making.

- Assess the impact of operational initiatives, process changes, and business programs.

- Identify emerging issues and opportunities before they become significant business challenges.

- Support prioritization efforts by helping leaders understand operational impacts, risks, and potential outcomes.

- Assist with business cases and operational assessments to support investment and improvement decisions.

Operational Oversight & Governance

- Monitor operational performance and program health across Business Operations.

- Evaluate adherence to business objectives, standards, and operational expectations.

- Identify recurring issues, process breakdowns, and areas requiring additional oversight.

- Support leadership with performance reviews, governance discussions, and operational assessments.

- Promote a culture of accountability through fact-based analysis and performance visibility.

Continuous Improvement

- Identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, operational outcomes, and customer experience.

- Analyze root causes of recurring challenges and recommend corrective actions.

- Support process improvement and transformation initiatives through research, analysis, and outcome tracking.

- Measure and communicate the effectiveness of improvement initiatives.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Partner with leaders across Business Operations to understand business priorities and performance objectives.

- Facilitate discussions around trends, risks, operational challenges, and improvement opportunities.

- Present findings and recommendations to both operational and executive audiences.

- Act as a trusted advisor by translating complex information into clear, actionable insights.

Job Requirements
Education

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in business analysis, operational performance, strategy, consulting, program management, or a related discipline.

- Experience analyzing business performance and translating findings into actionable recommendations.

- Experience supporting leadership teams with decision-making and strategic planning.

- Experience working across multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.

Skills

- Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.

- Ability to identify patterns, trends, risks, and opportunities from multiple sources of information.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong presentation and executive communication capabilities.

- Ability to influence without direct authority.

- Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and Microsoft Office applications.

What Success Looks Like

- Leadership gains clear visibility into organizational performance and emerging risks.

- Business decisions are supported by insightful analysis and practical recommendations.

- Trends and opportunities are identified proactively rather than reactively.

- Improvement initiatives are informed by data and measurable business outcomes.

- Operational leaders view the role as a trusted advisor and strategic thought partner.

- Cross-functional insights help drive greater effectiveness, scalability, and operational maturity.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

- Salary Range: $130,000 - $140,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)

- This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.

- Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

We’ll be accepting applications for at least one week from the date this role is posted. If you're interested, we encourage you to apply soon—we’re excited to find the right person and will keep the role open until we do!

title: Database Administrator, Global
description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Overview
Vantage is seeking a mid-level Database Administrator with experience installing, upgrading, and patching database servers and software across both Windows and Linux environments. This role also includes managing and administering cloud-based database solutions.

The successful candidate will be confident writing queries and developing tables, program views, functions, and stored procedures. They will have experience tuning queries and troubleshooting poor query performance, as well as a strong understanding of data protection and high-availability solutions to ensure business continuity in the event of server failure, data corruption, or user errors. They will be able to use server telemetry software to manage a collection of servers and provide status on the data environment.

As Vantage continues to grow, they will  also play an important role in identifying opportunities and strategies to improve processes for data migrations and process automation, which may include programming and using relevant tools.

Essential Job Functions

- Install, patch, upgrade and manage Microsoft SQL Server databases.

- Administer Ubuntu Linux servers.

- Manage server disk space capacity through adding more storage, or archiving storage and then migrating data as needed.

- Ensure database backups are completed regularly and conduct testing to ensure backups are usable.

- Provide tables, views, stored procedures, and functions to facilitate data use by reporting software and other applications.

- Manage database level partitioning where appropriate to manage data.

- Assist users with data requests and queries, provide guidance on query tuning for queries that perform poorly.

- Manage database resources in the cloud, and manage the costs associated with them.

- Manage servers in a database or server telemetry product.

- Write, update, and manage documentation on the database environment.

- Add, update, and remove users from the database servers.

- Migrate data from similar or different database platforms, such as from MySQL to PostgreSQL, or PostgreSQL to PostgreSQL.

- Participate in an on-call rotation for emergency server issues.

Job Requirements

- Fluent English language skills, both spoken and written

- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Information Systems/Computer Science) or Engineering, or equivalent experience.

- 2-4 years of production database administration experience with Microsoft SQL Server.

- 1-3 years experience with PostgreSQL is a plus.

- 1-3 years of production Linux server experience.

- Experience with Tableau, Power BI or SQL Server Reporting Services is a plus.

- Experience developing in Python, Java, C#, or Go is a plus.

- Proven to be highly accurate and thorough in all tasks.

- Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills are required, along with logical process thinking, the ability to multitask in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and the ability to contribute quickly.

- Genuine drive and motivation with a “can do” attitude, results-driven and committed to the future growth of Vantage, our customer’s success and your own career growth.

- Travel is expected to be less than 5%, but may increase over time as the business evolves.
